Package

io.webagent4j.observation
The immutable semantic observation model, options, renderers, diff, fingerprint, and the batch-capture backend SPI (io.webagent4j.observation.spi) - depends on webagent4j-dom and webagent4j-locator-api only, never on a browser backend.
